description: MCP server exposing 8004Swap (no-KYC agent-to-agent RFQ swap) as tools any MCP agent can call.
name: io.github.Stakemate369/8004swap-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Dedicated wallet private key for this agent (testnet). Required only for tools that sign: request_quote, fill_quote, register_agent. check_agent_status works without it. Never reuse a key that holds funds outside this testnet.
environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: 8004Swap Relay WebSocket URL. Defaults to the current Base Sepolia testnet deployment if omitted.
environmentVariables.name: RELAY_URL

environmentVariables.description: Base Sepolia RPC URL. Defaults to https://sepolia.base.org if omitted.
environmentVariables.name: RPC_URL
